items.statement: Repo previously claimed on-catalogue dots 'cannot earn credit yet cost 0.2' (guaranteed B2 gain). Official forum 11516 (DrivenData staff): known-fault pixels are masked/excluded in BOTH rounds, so on-catalogue dots cost 0. Any B2 gain is confined to unmasked 1-2px flank dots with k<alpha*DTI.
items.mitigation: PhD answer corrected in README + home page 2026-10-21
